title: BSU Sp 02 sweet potato (Benguet 1): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: BSU Sp 02 sweet potato: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: BSU Sp 02 sweet potato is a sweet potato variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: BSU Sp 02 is a registered sweet potato variety, also sold or known as Benguet 1. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2003 as NSIC 2003 Sp 27. Its record notes 8.51 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Benguet 1, this is the same sweet potato. The facts below come from the NSIC registry kept by the Bureau of Plant Industry. Compare it with the others in our [sweet potato variety finder](/crop-varieties/sweet-potato), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for root crops](/land-preparation/root-crop-land-preparation).

items: **Yield:** 8.51 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about BSU Sp 02 sweet potato
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Its average yield of 8.51 t/ha trails the average of its group, 15.15. It sits in the lower quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit sweet potato fields most often: [root knot nematode](/diseases/root-knot-nematode). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Its roots have yellow flesh and light red skin. Dry matter is 33.82 percent. A higher dry matter cooks mealy and gives processors more flour or starch from each tonne. The starch content is 13.58 percent.
Where and when to plant BSU Sp 02 sweet potato

The registry recommends it for anywhere in the country. Pick by use and market: yellow or orange flesh for snacks and fries, purple for processing, white for boiling. Weevils are the main enemy, so plant clean cuttings and harvest on time.

items.q: Is Benguet 1 the same as BSU Sp 02?
items.a: Yes. Benguet 1 is another name for BSU Sp 02, registered as NSIC 2003 Sp 27. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
The record shows 8.51 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
The registry recommends it for anywhere in the country. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of BSU Sp 02?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
